items.title: Is Dollar General (DG) Still Trading At A Discount To Fair Value?
items.summary: Dollar General stock has recovered over the past year but is still well below its level of five years ago, while both intrinsic value estimates and market multiples currently point to it trading at a discount to what the business may be worth. Recent earnings and management changes have put fresh attention on whether that discount is still justified.
